posts.title: Switzy
posts.description: Book review for Switzy by Emma Cline. I rated it 4.5 stars. Switzy's bold orange cover along with its short title made me think this was going to be more of a trendy contemporary fiction novel, so I was surprised to find out that it's actually about dementia. The book places us within the mind of 70-year-old David as he attempts to keep a handle on his everyday life while battling with a fading me

posts.title: Ducks in November: some new arrivals in Tokyo
posts.description: I went for a walk along my local river earlier this month, and it turned out to be a rather good birding session. There are always some ducks and other common river birds about, but it seems lately a number of new visitors have been making themselves at home.

posts.title: Mt Daibosatsu (大菩薩嶺)
posts.description: Mt Daibosatsu (大菩薩嶺, daibosatsu-rei) is one of Japan's Hundred Famous Mountains in Yamanashi prefecture with stunning views of Mt Fuji. Its short hiking course also makes it a great day-trip from Tokyo for beginner hikers. And with an elevation of only 2057m, it can be hiked for most months in the year without snow as well.
